deduplication.predecessorRelation: consumes the predecessor's binding receipt as its mandatory join key
deduplication.note: Third wave of the governed-inference lane chain: binding contract -> capture harness contract -> workspace readout (szl-holdings/a11oy#2020 steps 2-4).

candidate.title: Residual-stream capture harness contract v1
candidate.note: No capture exists yet; this wave defines what a capture receipt must carry so no readout claim may be made from an uncontracted capture.

joinKey.name: bindingReceipt
joinKey.rule: Every capture receipt carries the DSSE receipt id of the bound route it ran on. A capture without a valid binding receipt is invalid by construction; the estate never captures on an unbound route.

requiredFields.name: exactRevisions
requiredFields.rule: Model and tokenizer revisions echoed verbatim from the binding receipt; any mismatch fails the capture before it starts.

requiredFields.name: captureConfig
requiredFields.rule: Layers sampled (all or explicit stride), hook points, tensor dtype, and sequence boundary policy are declared and hashed into the receipt. Undeclared captures cannot anchor a claim.

requiredFields.name: storageClass
requiredFields.rule: Captured residual streams live in ephemeral storage only (tmpfs or equivalent); captured tensors never persist beyond the governed session boundary.

requiredFields.name: captureReceipt
requiredFields.rule: A partial-DSSE receipt binds bindingReceiptId + captureConfigHash + inference receipt hash. Readout steps consume only capture receipts.

requiredFields.name: failureDisposition
requiredFields.rule: Capture failure, partial capture, or config drift produces abstention: no readout claim, no labeled receipt field, no silent fallback to behavioral output alone presented as workspace evidence.

relationToWorkspaceReadout.rule: Step 2 of the measurement order is satisfied by a capture receipt against this contract running on a bound route. Steps 3-4 remain blocked until then.

claimSurfaces: No residual stream has been captured; no capture receipt exists; no readout has run.
This wave changes no runtime; it defines the contract a future harness must satisfy.
Behavioral output alone is never presented as workspace evidence.
